images.description: Real Snowsight screenshot from Snowflake's own official 'Getting Started with Snowpark in Snowflake Python Worksheets and Notebooks' quickstart (Snowflake-Labs/sfquickstarts GitHub repo), showing the Notebooks area in Snowsight where Snowpark DataFrame code actually runs.

imageNote: This lesson is primarily the Snowpark Python DataFrame API itself (session.table/filter/select/group_by, transformations vs. actions) — genuinely code-first content, not a UI walkthrough. One real Snowsight screenshot is used to ground where this code runs (Python Worksheets/Notebooks), everything else is real, syntactically-correct Snowpark code on code slides.
